author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Michael Busch goes deep Wednesday
desc: Michael Busch went 2-for-6 with a home run, two runs scored and an RBI in Wednesday's 23-3 win over the San Diego Padres.
impact: Busch capped the Cubs' 23-run effort with a 412-foot solo homer off Rodolfo Duran in the eighth inning. He's homered in back-to-back games and owns a .235 AVG and .765 OPS with 11 home runs on the year.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Miguel Amaya drives in three runs Wednesday
desc: Miguel Amaya went 2-for-4 with three runs scored and three RBI in Wednesday's 23-3 win over the San Diego Padres.
impact: While Amaya did not contribute to the Chicago Cubs' eight home runs in the contest, he drove in three runs with a two-run single in the third inning and an RBI single in the eighth. He's having his best season yet, posting a career-high .359 OBP to go with a .715 OPS through 48 games.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Seiya Suzuki goes yard Wednesday
desc: Seiya Suzuki went 3-for-5 with one home run, one double, one walk, three runs scored and three RBI in Wednesday's 23-3 win over the San Diego Padres.
impact: Suzuki kicked off the scoring for the Chicago Cubs in their 23-run effort, hitting a three-run home run off Walker Buehler in the first inning. He's riding a six-game hitting streak and has homered three times during that span.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Pete Crow-Armstrong takes one deep Wednesday
desc: Pete Crow-Armstrong went 2-for-4 with a home run, two runs scored, three RBI and a stolen base in Wednesday's 23-3 win over the San Diego Padres.
impact: After hitting 11 homers in June, Crow-Armstrong kicked off July with another one, launching a 390-foot shot off lefty Kyle Hart in the fifth inning. He's having quite the year, as he's tied for the league lead among outfielders with 21 stolen bases while ranking third in homers with 19.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Dansby Swanson hits three dingers Wednesday
desc: Dansby Swanson went 3-for-5 with three home runs, four runs scored and eight RBI in Wednesday's 23-3 win over the San Diego Padres.
impact: Swanson cannot be stopped right now, as he finished the series 8-for-13 with five home runs, a double, seven runs scored and 11 RBI. He's been a completely different hitter at the plate, going from a .183/.293/.330 slash line with seven home runs at the start of June to a .333/.371/.895 slash line with nine homers over his last 15 games. Fantasy managers should continue to ride the wave.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Colin Rea picks up win Wednesday
desc: Colin Rea allowed two runs on six hits and three runs while striking out five across five innings in Wednesday's 23-3 win over the San Diego Padres.
impact: The Chicago Cubs gave Rea a three-run lead by the second inning, and it had grown to nine by the fourth, providing him with plenty of run support. He took full advantage, allowing just two runs, both of which came in the fifth inning. Over his last three starts, he has allowed just three runs while striking out 12 across 15.1 innings. His next scheduled start is on Wednesday against the Baltimore Orioles.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Mookie Betts scratched from lineup Wednesday
desc: Mookie Betts has been scratched from the lineup by the Los Angeles Dodgers due to right wrist soreness Wednesday according to Kirsten Watson.
impact: Betts will take a seat on the bench Wednesday night, with Miguel Rojas taking his spot at shortstop against the Athletics Wednesday night.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Will Smith (neck) expected to be out through All-Star break
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts announced that he expects Will Smith to be sidelined until after the All-Star break.
impact: Smith has been on the shelf since June 11th with neck inflammation, and it looks like he will miss at least a few more weeks. The catcher was slashing .249/.338/.382 with six homers in 52 games before his injury. Dalton Rushing will continue to handle most of the catching work as Chuckie Robinson serves as his backup.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Brent Rooker to undergo season-ending knee surgery
desc: Brent Rooker is set to undergo season-ending left knee surgery to address cartilage damage.
impact: Rooker has been on the injured list with a bone bruise since June 12th, but the injury will now require surgery that will end his season. The outfielder slashed .200/.281/.389 with 10 home runs and 29 RBI in 48 games played.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Matt Chapman (abdominal) placed on injured list
desc: Matt Chapman has been placed on the 10-day injured list with an abdominal strain by the San Francisco Giants according to Susan Slusser.
impact: Chapman will look to avoid an extended stay on the injured list after exiting Tuesday night's loss with the injury. In a corresponding move, the Giants recalled Christian Koss from Triple-A Fresno.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Helsley dealing with elbow discomfort
desc: Orioles manager Craig Albernaz said Ryan Helsley was unavailable on Wednesday against the White Sox due to right elbow discomfort.
impact: Helsley had been warming up before he sat down. There should be an update when he is further evaluated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Eric Cerantola optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Royals optioned RHP Eric Cerantola to Triple-A Omaha.
impact: Cerantola will return to Triple-A for a fresh arm.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kris Bubic transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Royals transferred LHP Kris Bubic to the 60-day injured list.
impact: The move opens up a spot on the 40-man roster for Kansas City. There should be an update on Bubic in the coming days.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Connor Seabold (lat) placed on IL
desc: The Royals placed RHP Connor Seabold on the 15-day injured list with a right lat strain.
impact: Seabold left his latest appearance early. He'll be sidelined for at least the next couple of weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Randy Dobnak recalled by Royals
desc: The Royals recalled RHP Randy Dobnak from Triple-A Omaha.
impact: Dobnak will add a fresh arm in the bullpen for Kansas City.
